tips.summary: Repeat a motion with a count 5j
details: Operators take counts too
3dw deletes 3 words
2d3w multiplies to 6 words
Handy for line numbers in errors
:120 then Enter does the same

tips.summary: Move by words w / b / e
details: w next word start
b previous word start
e moves to end of word

tips.summary: Jump to previous word end ge / gE
details: gE counts foo.bar() as one word
Nice for edits before punctuation

tips.summary: Move by big WORDs W / B / E
details: W next WORD, B back, E to end
A WORD is split only on spaces
W hops over foo.bar() in one go
In fooBarBaz, [w hops to Bar
[b hops back, d[w deletes ahead
0 goes to the very first column
^ stops at first non-blank char
Lands on the last char of the line
d$ deletes to the end of the line

tips.summary: Jump to last non-blank on line g_
details: Unlike $, it skips trailing spaces
vg_ selects without the line break

tips.summary: Jump to text on next line + and -
details: + down to next line's first text
- up to previous line's first text
d+ deletes both lines

tips.summary: Jump to last change lines '[ and ']
details: '[ jumps to the change's first line
'] jumps to its last line
80| jumps to column 80
81|D trims the line to 80 chars

tips.summary: Jump to file top/bottom gg / G
details: gg goes to the first line
G goes to the last line
dG deletes to the end of the file
50% jumps halfway down the file
10% jumps near the top
H top of screen, M middle, L bottom
No scrolling, just the cursor moves

tips.summary: Move by wrapped lines gj / gk
details: j skips a wrapped line in one go
gj and gk stop at each screen row
Turn on soft wrap with :set wrap

tips.summary: Wrapped line start or end g0 / g$
details: g0 goes to this screen row's start
g$ to its end, g^ to its first text
Turn on soft wrap with :set wrap
{ goes to previous paragraph
} goes to next paragraph
d} deletes to the next blank line
( jumps back a sentence
) jumps forward a sentence
d) deletes the rest of a sentence
Cursor can sit before the bracket
d% deletes through its partner
]} jumps to the closing }, [{ to {
]) and [( do the same for parens
d]} deletes to the block end
`` jumps back to the exact spot
'' jumps back to that line
Repeat it to hop back and forth
Ctrl-o steps back to older jumps
Ctrl-i steps forward again
Works across files, like after gd
Lists stored jump locations
Pair with Ctrl-o / Ctrl-i
Lands on the exact spot you changed
'. goes to the line instead
g; goes to an older change position
g, moves back toward newer ones

tips.summary: Find a character on the line f / F
details: fx jumps to the next x on the line
Fx jumps back to the previous x

tips.summary: Move till a character t / T
details: t) stops just before the next )
T( stops just after the previous (
Perfect for ct) edits
; repeats in same direction
, repeats in opposite direction

tips.summary: Set and jump to a mark ma / `a
details: ma tags the current spot as mark a
`a returns exactly, 'a to the line

tips.summary: Mark a spot across files mA
details: 'A jumps back to it from any file
It shows as an IDE bookmark too
:marks shows active marks
Check before jumping with ' or `
:delmarks a b removes marks a and b
:delmarks! clears marks a to z
Works across files and libraries
Ctrl-o jumps back when you're done

tips.summary: Go to definition and back Ctrl-]
details: Ctrl-t returns to where you jumped
Even after moving around there
]m jumps to the next method start
[m jumps to the previous one
]M and [M do the same for the ends
zt top, zz center, zb bottom
Use after a search or big jump
Ctrl-d scrolls down half a page
Ctrl-u scrolls up half a page
Ctrl-f scrolls forward one page
Ctrl-b scrolls back one page
Ctrl-e scrolls down one line
Ctrl-y scrolls up one line
zh scrolls left, zl scrolls right
zH and zL move half a screen
Needs soft wrap off, the default

tips.summary: Place cursor screen edge zs / ze
details: zs shows cursor at screen start
ze shows cursor at screen end
Needs soft wrap off, the default
zfip folds the current paragraph
Takes any motion, like zf} or zfa{
zd deletes it; IDE folds come back
Select lines with V, then press zf
za then toggles your new fold
Opens it if closed, closes if open
One key covers most fold work

tips.summary: Force a fold open or closed zo / zc
details: zo always opens, zc always closes
Use when toggle za isn't enough
zA toggles it and every inner fold
One key for the whole fold tree

tips.summary: Force nested folds open or closed
details: zO opens every nested level
zC closes every nested level
zj moves to the next fold start
zk moves to the previous fold start

tips.summary: Fold all / unfold all zM / zR
details: zM closes all folds in view
zR opens all folds in view

tips.summary: Control fold depth with zr / zm
details: zr opens one fold level
zm closes one fold level

tips.summary: Open the URL under the cursor gx
details: Opens with your default browser
Cursor can sit anywhere in it
